title: Football transfer rumours: Liverpool in for Lazio's Thomas Strakosha?
trail: West Ham also to raid Lazio for Felipe Anderson and Jordan Lukaku? | Manchester United target Ryan Sessegnon, Kieran Tierney and Jérôme Boateng? | Arsenal eye Bayer Leverkusen’s Bernd Leno?
body: Once, after his spectacles were knocked off and broken during boisterous goalscoring celebrations by Liverpool at Norwich, Jürgen Klopp was moved to note: “I have a second pair but I couldn’t find them. It’s hard to find glasses without glasses.” The Mill doesn’t know what has happened to Klopp’s eyewear this week but there are extraordinary reports that he is having trouble finding a better goalkeeper than Loris Karius or Simon Mignolet. That has been interpreted as a slight on traffic cones, not to mention members of the scarecrow community, but Klopp is unrepentant and for a while bystanders were worried that if Liverpool couldn’t work out deals for Alisson or Jan Oblak, their manager would be happy to start next season with Karius or Mignolet between the sticks. Those fears have been allayed, however, by rumblings that Liverpool have started sniffing around the Lazio keeper Thomas Strakosha. Word is that Liverpool could bag Strakosha for less than half the fee being demanded for Oblak or Alisson (who’s said to be on his way to Real Madrid, anyway). And they may be able to parlay the sum down even more if they throw in the midfielder Marko Grujic, for whom Lazio have a soft spot. West Ham also want a word with Lazio. The east London club’s new manager, Manuel Pellegrini, wants his employers to prise two players from the Italian side: the midfielder Felipe Anderson and the left-back Jordan Lukaku, the younger brother of Romelu. Pellegrini also wants to lure the teenage schemer Brahim Díaz from his former club Manchester City. Manchester United are supposedly after a new left-back despite the Mill informing you less than 48 hours ago about gossip insisting that José Mourinho has decided to give Luke Shaw another chance. The claim now – and it may be every bit as reliable as the previous claim – is that Mourinho wants either Ryan Sessegnon or Kieran Tierney. United are also considering competing with Manchester City for the affections of Jérôme Boateng, who will be allowed to leave Bayern Munich this summer. Barcelona, meanwhile, hope that Thiago Alcântara will also be allowed to leave the German club. Arsenal, like Liverpool, are on the hunt for a goalkeeper and are still fixating on Bernd Leno. A deal with Bayer Leverkusen is said to be creeping closer. Everton’s new manager, Marco Silva, wants to be reunited with Abdoualye Doucouré but Spurs also fancy the Watford midfielder. Finally, back to Liverpool, whose rumoured pursuit of the PSG forward Gonçalo Guedes looks doomed to failure. Wolves, Internazionale and Napoli face similar disappointment, as the Portuguese player has apparently indicated that he prefers a move to Spain.
